description.value: Kamikaze Sushi is a quick-service sushi counter in the Woodgrove Mall Food Court in north Nanaimo, offering rolls, poke bowls, ramen, and bento boxes made fresh daily on-site. The kitchen sources ingredients from local suppliers and uses traditional Japanese techniques, with a menu broad enough to suit vegetarians alongside seafood lovers. It is accessible via delivery apps or phone-ahead takeout, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the Woodgrove area.
